notes.title: New Update 0.2!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Survivors![/b]

New update available!

[h3]In Update:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Achievements
[*] Added time in the game
[*] Added compass markers
[*] Fixed a problem with a magazine with 1 bullet
[*] After death, a marker with the distance to the backpack will appear on the compass
[*] AirDrop
[*] Added ability to change control settings
[*] Changed save system (need to start a new game, if still not working let me know)
[*] Increased cycle time of the day
[/list]



[h3]In the next update is planned:[/h3][list]
[*] Interface change
[*] Enlarged new map
[*] Quest system
[*] And much more
[/list]

notes.title: Release Game in EA!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, very soon the game will be available for download.
Bugs are possible in the game, so if you want to get a fully working version I recommend waiting for the full release of the game.
You can share your suggestions for improving the game in the community or on the discord channel https://discord.gg/usetHMB
Welcome to Fallen Region!
